text.title: Grocery retailer FreshDrop, food delivery, assessment 1 September 2026
text.c11: Lock in early buyers: free first delivery, lead the Moscow market
text.c12: Expand to new districts; invest in courier capacity
text.c13: Defend share: loyalty bonuses and fixed slots
text.c14: Harvest cash: cut paid promos, keep the core
text.c21: Build the base: referral bonus and fast onboarding
text.c22: Invest to grow: new districts and weekly boxes
text.c23: Protect margin: raise basket size, not promos
text.c24: Hold position: automate support, cut costs
text.c31: Test a niche: family boxes in 2 districts
text.c32: Focus on 2 districts where we lead
text.c33: Differentiate: fast delivery and fresh goods
text.c34: Consider a partnership or exit weak districts
text.c41: Partner with a store chain before scaling
text.c42: Keep pace with cost; no new markets yet
text.c43: Cut costs; run only profitable districts
text.c44: Sell or close the service in this district
text.c51: Do not enter alone; wait for a partner
text.c52: Exit or merge with a rival
text.c53: Exit unless the niche is profitable
text.c54: Exit now and close the service
text.cell: Moscow grocery delivery, Growth · Strong: share 14% in our districts
text.stage_basis: Orders grow 35% a year; 6 rivals in Moscow; shares stable for 2 quarters; high entry costs
text.position_basis: 14% share in our districts, second after a national chain; advantage: 30-minute slots
text.decision: Invest in courier capacity and 3 new districts; review in Q1 2027 with the district P&L
text.risk: A rival cuts prices; orders stop growing (change of stage); the share comes from a survey
